name: disk_free
description: free disk space on a volume is below an amount, as in 'when storage is below 5G'
command: df -Pk "$VOLUME" | awk -v lim="$BELOW_GB" -v vol="$VOLUME" 'NR == 2 { gb = $4 / 1048576; print sprintf("%.1f GB free on %s", gb, vol); found = 1; exit !(gb < lim) } END { if (!found) exit 2 }'
text: When free space on $VOLUME is below $BELOW_GB GB
